posts.title: A place for connected ideas
posts.summary: An introduction to this bilingual collection of essays and working notes.
posts.text: This is an example post showing how a published article appears. Replace it with your own text, equations, citations, and links. One notebook, two languages The English and Hebrew editions share a structure, but each post can exist in one language or in both. A translation is never created or displayed unless you write it. Mathematics stays readable Inline mathematics such as E = mc² remains part of the sentence, while displayed equations receive their own space: $$\mathcal{A}(s,t)=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n(t)s^n.$$ The source for every post remains a normal LaTeX or LyX document.

posts.title: Symmetry as a way of organizing a calculation
posts.summary: A short example of a physics note with displayed mathematics.
posts.text: Symmetry is most useful when it reduces the number of independent questions in a calculation. A compact example If an amplitude admits a partial-wave expansion, $$\mathcal{A}(s,x)=\sum_{\ell=0}^{\infty} a_{\ell}(s)\,C_{\ell}^{(\lambda)}(x),$$ then the choice of basis makes rotational symmetry manifest. Questions about the full angular dependence become questions about the coefficients a_(ℓ)(s). This sample can be deleted once the first real physics post is ready.

posts.title: A first look at conformal symmetry
posts.summary: An example post in Physics → Conformal Field Theory, about symmetry and scale.
posts.text: This example post belongs to Conformal Field Theory, a subtopic of Physics. Symmetry and scale A scale transformation enlarges or shrinks distances by the same factor. Conformal transformations preserve angles locally, while allowing the scale factor to vary from point to point. These symmetries strongly constrain correlation functions in conformal field theory. They provide a starting point for studying how observables depend on the separation between points. Explore the subtopic Choose Physics in the tag menu to reveal Conformal Field Theory. Selecting that subtag shows the posts filed under it.

posts.title: Listening for patterns
posts.summary: A sample music post about repetition, variation, and expectation.
posts.text: A repeated phrase is never heard in exactly the same context twice. What sounded like an opening can return as a memory, a question, or a conclusion. Repetition and change The interest often lies in the small displacement: a changed bass note, a delayed entrance, a silence where the ear expected an answer. Structure becomes audible through difference.
